dragon_ability.additional_abilities.test: Annulus Test

§7■ A test ability for the §6「Annulus」§7 target type (§fadditional_abilities:annulus§7).

■ Affected entities §fglow§7, and the selection volume is a §fring§7 around you — blocks and entities inside the inner radius are §fleft untouched§7.

■ Press §fF3+B§7 to see the selection boxes: §bcyan§r is the outer bound, §8dark cyan§r is the inner (hollowed) bound.

■ §8Not attached to any species — grant it with a command.
Anti-Dragon-Breath Test

§7■ A test ability for the §6「Reverse Cone」§7 target type (§fadditional_abilities:anti_dragon_breath§7).

■ Everything behaves like the §fDragon Breath§7 cone, except the selection box extends §fbehind the caster§7.

■ Affected entities §fglow§7, and white particles fill the box §2(so the reversed volume is visible to the eye)§r.

■ §8Not attached to any species — grant it with a command.
Block Quake Test

§7■ A test ability for the §6「Block Quake」§7 block effect (§fadditional_abilities:block_quake§7).

■ §fIts exact behaviour and numbers change while the effect is being tuned§7, so this description stays vague.

■ §8Not attached to any species — grant it with a command.
Charged Test

§7■ A test ability for the §6「Charged」§7 activation type.

■ §fHold§7 the ability key to charge — the longer you hold, the higher the §flevel§7 actually used by the effect.

■ Release §fafter the minimum charge§7 to cast at the level you reached; releasing §fearlier§7 cancels the cast.

■ Holding all the way to the §fcast time§7 releases automatically at your highest level.
Charged Hold Test

§7■ Same as §6「Charged Test」§7, but with §fcan_charge_exceed_cast_time§7 enabled and §fmax_overcharged_duration: 20§7 set.

■ Hold §fpast the cast time§7 — the charge stays at your highest level and the indicator keeps showing it.

■ The overcharge window is §f20 ticks§7: you may hold at most 20 ticks past the cap, then it §ffires automatically at your highest tier§7 (releasing inside the window fires at your highest tier too).
Domain Test

§7■ A test ability for the §6Domain§7 target selector (§fadditional_abilities:domain§7).

■ Finishing the cast leaves a §fspherical§7 domain of radius §f5§7 at the §fcasting position§7. It lasts §f10§7 seconds and ticks every §f1§7 second.

■ §fAllies and yourself§7 inside keep gaining §fRegeneration§7 and §fGlowing§7, with particles.

■ The domain §fdoes not follow you§7 — it keeps working where it was cast until the time runs out.

■ §8Not attached to any dragon species; grant it with a command.
Block Glow Test

§7■ A test ability for the §6「Block Glow」§7 block effect (§fadditional_abilities:glow§7).

■ On cast, centred on you: blocks within §f3 blocks§7 take the §6tint§7 path (gold, semi-transparent), while blocks out to §f6 blocks§7 get a §bcyan wireframe§7 only. The inner ring is therefore covered by §fboth display types at once§7, which shows that different sources stack instead of overriding each other.

■ §fFully occluded§7 and §fnon-full-shaped§7 blocks never take the tint path (flip §fhide_occluded§7 to §ffalse§7 in the JSON for comparison).

■ Lasts §f6 seconds§7 and expires on its own; recasting on the same spot only refreshes the duration.

■ §8Not attached to any species — grant it with a command.
On Ability Cast Test

§7■ Test ability for the§6 "On Ability Cast"§7 passive trigger type (§fadditional_abilities:on_ability_cast§7).

■ Cast any ability§f listed in abilities§7 (by default §fadditional_abilities:test_screen_vision§7 and §fadditional_abilities:test_charged§7); once§f that cast settles§7 you gain§f Glowing§7 and emit particles.

■ abilities accepts a§f single ability id§7, a§f list of ids§7 or a§f #tag§7; when§f omitted, any active ability§7 will trigger it.

■ §8Not attached to any species — grant it with a command.
On Block Placed Test

§7■ A test ability for the §6「On Block Placed」§7 passive trigger type (§fadditional_abilities:on_block_placed§7).

■ Placing a block grants you §fGlowing§7 and spawns particles around you.

■ The built-in §fcondition§7 (§f#minecraft:dirt§7) demonstrates the §fblock loot context§7 predicate — placing anything that is §fnot dirt§7 will not trigger it.

■ §8Not attached to any species — grant it with a command.
On Item Consumed Test

§7■ A test ability for the §6「On Item Consumed」§7 passive trigger type (§fadditional_abilities:on_item_consumed§7).

■ Eating or drinking a §fmatching item§7 grants you §fGlowing§7 and spawns particles around you.

■ The built-in §fitem§7 predicate (§f#minecraft:meat§7) demonstrates the §fItemPredicate§7 syntax §7— eating anything that is §fnot meat§7 will not trigger it.

■ §8Not attached to any species — grant it with a command.
Optional Charged Test

§7■ The test ability for the §6「Optional Charged」§7 activation type.

■ Hold §fthe ability key§7 to charge. While charging, §fscroll the mouse wheel§7 to pick the tier you want to release: scroll up to raise it, scroll down to lower it.

■ You can only pick tiers you have §falready charged up to§7 — on the indicator, the left number is the tier you picked and the grey number after it is the tier you have reached.

■ Scroll all the way down to §f0§7 to §fcancel§7: releasing then casts nothing at all — no mana, no cooldown.

■ Scrolling back up to the reached tier returns to §fauto-follow§7 (which behaves like the §6「Charged」§7 type): releasing then casts at the tier you reached.
Screen Vision Test

§7■ A test ability for the §6「Screen Vision」§7 entity effect (§fadditional_abilities:simple_screen_vision§7).

■ §fIts exact behaviour and numbers change while the effect is being tuned§7, so this description stays vague.

■ §8Not attached to any species — grant it with a command.
additional_abilities.configuration.charg: Which side of the cast bar the indicator sits on. All four follow the cast bar, so if you move the Dragon Survival cast bar the indicator moves with it.

The sound played each time the charge tier goes up; its pitch rises with the tier (the curve is set by the three options below). Only eight presets — the config system cannot offer every registered sound, and vanilla alone has 1486 of them, far too many for a dropdown. After switching sounds, retune the pitch curve.
Pitch ceiling (0.5 - 2.0). The game's sound engine itself clamps pitch to [0.5, 2.0], so 2.0 is already the hard limit; lowering it makes the pitch stop rising earlier.
Pitch at tier 1 (0.5 - 2.0), default 0.9; 1.0 is the sound's original pitch.
How much the pitch rises per tier gained (0.0 - 1.0), default 0.12; 0 keeps a single pitch for every tier.
Pixels to shift the indicator horizontally on top of the chosen placement (GUI-scaled pixels; positive is right).
Pixels to shift the indicator vertically on top of the chosen placement (GUI-scaled pixels; positive is down).

The overcharge row of the readout turns red once the remaining fraction of the window is at or below this value; 0.3 turns red at the 30%% point and 0 disables it. A fraction adapts to each ability's window length. Colour only, no sound.

Plays a sound each time the charge tier goes up, plus a shorter click when picking a tier with the wheel. Turning it off silences both (Dragon Survival's own charging / release sounds are unaffected).

Master multiplier, 0.0 - 1.0, applied on top of each sound's own base volume (0.7 for the tier sound, 0.6 for the wheel click; the difference is intentional). Default 1.0 matches the previous loudness; only takes effect while the toggle above is on.
